# weka Provider

Configures a running Weka cluster through its REST API: filesystems, filesystem groups, organizations, users, object-store buckets and their filesystem attachments, snapshot policies, LDAP, and the account lockout policy. Cluster layout belongs to the Weka operator, not this provider.

## Example Usage

```terraform
provider "weka" {
  endpoint = "https://weka.example.com:14000"
  username = var.weka_username
  password = var.weka_password
  insecure = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `endpoint` (String) Cluster URL, e.g. `https://weka.example.com:14000`. `/api/v2` is appended if missing. Env: `WEKA_ENDPOINT`.
- `insecure` (Boolean) Skip TLS verification. Weka clusters ship a self-signed certificate. Env: `WEKA_INSECURE`.
- `org` (String) Organization to log in to. Defaults to `Root` on the server. Env: `WEKA_ORG`.
- `password` (String, Sensitive) Env: `WEKA_PASSWORD`.
- `username` (String) Env: `WEKA_USERNAME`.
